crossRefs.note: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her…
But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over…
But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people…
I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard…
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
translations.bsb: As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
translations.kjv: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
